entries.en: We found an old photograph of a cottage in Northants among the loose letters.
entries.zh: 我们在那些散放的信件中找到了一张北安普敦郡一间村舍的旧照片。

entries.en: Sergei balanced the empty tray on one hand while opening the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 塞奇一手托着空托盘，一边打开厨房门。

entries.en: Mrs Mountbatten lent us a ladder so we could retrieve the kite.
entries.zh: 蒙巴顿太太借给我们一架梯子，让我们能取回那只风筝。

entries.en: Armitage put the photographs aside and listened to the noise upstairs.
entries.zh: 阿米蒂奇把照片放到一边，听着楼上的动静。

entries.en: Smyth returned my keys before I even noticed they were missing.
entries.zh: 我还没察觉钥匙不见了，史密斯就把它们还给了我。

entries.en: Our reading group argued about Dr Jekyll until the librarian turned off the lights.
entries.zh: 我们读书小组一直争论着哲基尔医生这个人物，直到图书管理员关了灯。

entries.en: Hillsborough held the umbrella steady while I searched my bag for the tickets.
entries.zh: 希尔斯伯勒稳稳地举着伞，我则在包里找票。

entries.meaningZh: 妓女收容所〔英国历史用语〕
entries.en: In the historical novel, she leaves the magdalen with a bundle of clothes.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，她带着一包衣服离开了妓女收容所。

entries.en: The parcel for Ms Kaye was too large to fit through the letterbox.
entries.zh: 寄给凯耶女士的包裹太大，塞不进信箱口。

entries.en: A friend who lives in Falkirk sent me a photograph of her newly painted kitchen.
entries.zh: 一位住在福尔柯克的朋友寄给我一张她家新刷好的厨房的照片。

entries.en: The baby pulled off his dickie before I could wipe the porridge away.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及擦掉麦片粥，宝宝就扯下了自己的围嘴。

entries.en: In the faded photograph, a tarpaulin partly covers a minnie beside the trench.
entries.zh: 在那张褪色的照片中，战壕旁的一门迫击炮被防水布遮住了一部分。

entries.en: Mr Whyte stayed behind to help stack the chairs after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，怀特先生留下来帮忙把椅子摞好。

entries.en: Maguire wrapped the broken handle in paper and took it to the workshop.
entries.zh: 马奎尔用纸包起断掉的把手，把它带到了作坊。

entries.en: Latimer had almost finished the puzzle when the cat scattered the pieces.
entries.zh: 拉蒂默差点就拼好了拼图，猫却把拼块弄散了。

entries.en: She kept the letter from Nintendo beside her collection of old game manuals.
entries.zh: 她把任天堂寄来的那封信放在自己收藏的旧游戏说明书旁。

entries.en: The postcard from Granville arrived a week after its sender returned home.
entries.zh: 那张从格兰维尔寄出的明信片，在寄信人回家一周后才送到。

entries.en: Sykes found a dry bench where we could spread out the damp map.
entries.zh: 赛克斯找到一张干燥的长椅，让我们能把受潮的地图摊开。

entries.en: Lybrand counted the cups again because an unexpected guest had just arrived.
entries.zh: 莱布兰德又数了一遍杯子，因为刚刚来了一位意料之外的客人。

entries.en: Braithwaite offered to mend the gate, but we had already bought a replacement.
entries.zh: 布雷思韦特提出帮忙修院门，但我们已经买了一扇新的。

entries.en: The film club chose a still of Damien for its discussion poster.
entries.zh: 电影社选了一张达米安的剧照，用在讨论活动的海报上。

entries.en: Earle tucked the receipt into a book and promptly forgot which book it was.
entries.zh: 厄尔把收据夹进一本书里，随即就忘了是哪一本。

entries.en: We compared our photographs of Stansted while waiting for the kettle to boil.
entries.zh: 我们一边等水烧开，一边比较斯坦斯特德机场的照片。

entries.en: I left my shopping list at home and forgot to buy flour at Wellcome.
entries.zh: 我把购物清单落在家里，在顶好超市忘了买面粉。

entries.en: Davison moved the lamp closer so we could examine the torn photograph.
entries.zh: 戴维森把灯移近了些，让我们能仔细看那张撕破的照片。

entries.en: Ms Crowe brought a spare pair of gloves for whoever had forgotten theirs.
entries.zh: 克罗女士多带了一副手套，给忘了带手套的人用。

entries.en: Millar carefully lifted the model ship out of its cardboard box.
entries.zh: 米勒小心翼翼地把船模从纸箱里拿出来。

entries.en: Rifkind was still looking for a parking space when the rehearsal began.
entries.zh: 排练开始时，里夫金德还在找停车位。

entries.en: Cochrane put a bowl under the dripping water and went downstairs for towels.
entries.zh: 科克兰在滴水处下方放了一个碗，然后下楼拿毛巾。

entries.en: Annabel preferred the scratched wooden chair to the shiny new plastic one.
entries.zh: 比起崭新的亮面塑料椅，安娜贝尔更喜欢那把有划痕的木椅。

entries.en: Dixons waved from the opposite platform, but the approaching train blocked our view.
entries.zh: 迪克森在对面站台挥手，但驶来的列车挡住了我们的视线。

entries.en: The panel's argument about populism continued long after the audience had left.
entries.zh: 观众离开很久后，讨论小组对民粹主义的争论还在继续。

entries.en: Beatrix saved the last piece of ribbon for the smallest present.
entries.zh: 比阿特丽克斯把最后一段丝带留给了最小的那份礼物。

entries.en: Piggott slipped a folded newspaper under the wobbling leg of the table.
entries.zh: 皮戈特把一份折好的报纸塞到摇晃的桌腿下面。

entries.en: Antonia asked us to lower our voices because the baby had finally fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 安东尼娅请我们小声一些，因为宝宝终于睡着了。

entries.en: The envelope addressed to Cripps contained a photograph but no letter.
entries.zh: 那个写着克里普斯收的信封里有一张照片，却没有信。

entries.en: Stevie tried the spare key before climbing through the open window.
entries.zh: 史蒂夫先试了备用钥匙，然后才从开着的窗户爬进去。

entries.en: We paused the old television interview with Ellesmere to answer the door.
entries.zh: 我们暂停了那段蔡子健的旧电视采访，去应门。

entries.en: McDermott carried the empty flowerpots inside before the wind grew stronger.
entries.zh: 麦克德莫特在风变大之前把空花盆搬进了屋。

entries.en: Aviv found enough space on the shelf for both boxes of records.
entries.zh: 阿维夫在架子上找到了足够放下那两箱唱片的空间。

entries.en: Curran checked beneath the cushions before asking everyone to look for the remote.
entries.zh: 柯伦先检查了坐垫底下，才请大家帮忙找遥控器。

entries.en: A worn piece of Kidderminster covered the floor between the bed and the washstand.
entries.zh: 床和盥洗架之间的地板上铺着一块磨旧的基德明斯特地毯。

entries.en: Mrs Hewlett returned the bowl with a few homemade biscuits inside.
entries.zh: 休利特太太还回来的那个碗里装着几块自制饼干。

entries.en: Mademoiselle Laurent, your scarf has slipped behind the chair by the window.
entries.zh: 洛朗小姐，您的围巾滑到窗边那把椅子后面去了。

entries.en: Ingrid turned the damp coat inside out and hung it near the door.
entries.zh: 英格里德把潮湿的外套翻过来，挂在门边。

entries.en: Marlon pushed the trolley while I held the cake box level.
entries.zh: 马龙推着手推车，我则把蛋糕盒端平。

entries.en: The historian placed an old election leaflet from Beckenham beneath the glass.
entries.zh: 历史学者把一张来自贝肯汉姆选区的旧竞选传单放在玻璃下面。

entries.en: Stratton heard the bicycle bell and stepped away from the narrow path.
entries.zh: 斯特拉顿听见自行车铃声，便从狭窄的小路上让开了。

entries.en: McGrath promised to bring the missing chess piece to our next meeting.
entries.zh: 麦格拉答应下次见面时把那枚缺失的棋子带来。

entries.en: I found an old letter from Jardine Matheson between two pages of the scrapbook.
entries.zh: 我在剪贴簿的两页之间发现了一封怡和集团的旧来信。

entries.en: McMahon called across the garden to ask whether we needed more chairs.
entries.zh: 麦克马洪隔着花园大声问我们还需不需要椅子。

entries.en: Keswick waited with the luggage while I went back for the forgotten coat.
entries.zh: 凯瑟克守着行李等候，我则回去拿落下的外套。

entries.en: Hattersley drew the curtains halfway to keep the sun off the painting.
entries.zh: 哈特斯利把窗帘拉上一半，以免阳光照到那幅画。

entries.en: She packed a thick slice of parkin beside the sandwiches for our walk.
entries.zh: 她把一片厚厚的麦片姜饼放在三明治旁边，供我们散步时吃。

entries.meaningZh: 尼科尔棱镜〔较少用短称〕
entries.en: The technician put the damaged Nicol in a padded box for inspection.
entries.zh: 技术员把那枚受损的尼科尔棱镜放进有衬垫的盒子里，等待检查。

entries.en: We lowered the volume of the Keane album when the telephone rang.
entries.zh: 电话响起时，我们调低了正在播放的基恩乐团专辑的音量。

entries.meaningZh: 里昂〔塞拉利昂货币单位〕
entries.en: The old account book recorded each payment down to the last leone.
entries.zh: 那本旧账簿把每笔付款都记得很细，连最后一里昂也没有漏掉。

entries.en: Southwell had left a note explaining where to find the spare blankets.
entries.zh: 索斯韦尔留下了一张便条，说明备用毯子放在哪里。

entries.en: Kath watered the seedlings while I cleared the broken pots from the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 卡特给幼苗浇水，我则把温室里的破花盆清理出去。

entries.en: The envelope from Parma contained the little drawing I had been waiting for.
entries.zh: 从帕尔马寄来的信封里装着我一直在等的那幅小画。

entries.en: Glynn took a photograph of the shelf before dismantling it for the move.
entries.zh: 格林在为了搬家而拆卸架子之前，先给它拍了一张照片。

entries.en: Their rafferty arrangements left three volunteers at one door and nobody at the other.
entries.zh: 他们那混乱无章的安排让三名志愿者都待在一扇门口，另一扇门口却没有人。

entries.en: Hussey brought the washing in just before the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 赫西刚把晾着的衣物收进屋，雨点就落下来了。

entries.en: Portillo offered me the window seat so I could finish my sketch.
entries.zh: 波蒂略提出把靠窗的座位让给我，好让我完成素描。

entries.meaningZh: 萨克斯〔汽车零配件厂商名〕
entries.en: The archivist filed the old invoice from Sachs with the other suppliers' letters.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把萨克斯的旧发票和其他供货商的来信归档在一起。

entries.en: My friend who lives in Melrose sent back the gloves I had left at her house.
entries.zh: 住在梅尔罗斯的朋友把我落在她家的手套寄了回来。

entries.en: Fawcett tightened the loose handle before carrying the basket down the stairs.
entries.zh: 福西特先把松动的提手固定好，然后才提着篮子下楼。

entries.en: We spent the evening sorting photographs from our visit to Bootle.
entries.zh: 我们整个晚上都在整理到访布特尔期间的照片。

entries.en: She chose a photograph of Tiananmen for the first page of her travel album.
entries.zh: 她选了一张天安门的照片，放在旅行相册的第一页。

entries.en: An old election map of Bridgend was folded inside the historian's notebook.
entries.zh: 历史学者的笔记本里夹着一张折好的布里真德选区旧选举地图。

entries.en: Mohamed waited until the paint was dry before putting the books back.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德等油漆干了，才把书放回去。

entries.en: Sefton noticed a small tear in the tent while packing it away.
entries.zh: 塞夫顿收起帐篷时，发现上面有一道小裂口。

entries.en: Natasha carried the picnic basket steadily as we crossed the narrow bridge.
entries.zh: 我们过那座窄桥时，娜塔莎稳稳地提着野餐篮。

entries.en: Palmerston left a bicycle pump by the gate for the next visitor to borrow.
entries.zh: 帕默斯顿把一个自行车打气筒放在门边，供下一位来访者借用。

entries.en: Harwell lifted the paper boat from the water before it drifted beneath the little bridge.
entries.zh: 哈韦尔在纸船漂到小桥下面之前，把它从水里捞了起来。

entries.en: Mrs Wilberforce asked whether anyone had seen the lid of her teapot.
entries.zh: 威尔伯福斯太太问，有没有人见过她的茶壶盖。

entries.en: McEnroe folded the large drawing carefully enough to fit it into the envelope.
entries.zh: 麦肯罗小心地把那张大画折好，使它能装进信封。

entries.en: Aldridge offered to carry the flowers, leaving me free to open the doors.
entries.zh: 奥尔德里奇提出帮忙拿花，这样我就能腾出手开门。

entries.en: McBride found the missing screw beneath a pile of old catalogues.
entries.zh: 麦克布赖德在一摞旧商品目录下面找到了那颗丢失的螺丝。

entries.en: Hawke measured the doorway twice before helping us move the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 霍克把门口量了两遍，才帮我们搬衣柜。

entries.en: The small parcel for Wolsey had been left with a neighbour.
entries.zh: 寄给沃尔西的那个小包裹被放在了一位邻居那里。

entries.en: Barthes saved a seat for me near the back of the hall.
entries.zh: 巴尔泰斯在大厅后部附近给我留了一个座位。

entries.en: Vicki repaired the torn pocket instead of throwing the jacket away.
entries.zh: 维姬没有把那件夹克扔掉，而是补好了破口袋。

entries.en: Antoinette kept a clean cloth over the bread until the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 安托瓦内特用一块干净的布盖着面包，直到客人到来。

entries.en: We watched an old interview with Schumacher while waiting for our friends.
entries.zh: 我们等朋友时，看了一段采访赛车手舒马赫的旧节目。

entries.en: The lecturer used a portrait of Osman on the opening slide.
entries.zh: 讲师在开场幻灯片上用了一幅奥斯曼的肖像。

entries.en: Whelan suggested moving the table away from the window to make more room.
entries.zh: 惠兰建议把桌子从窗边移开，以腾出更多空间。

entries.en: Grenfell heard the knocking and hurried downstairs with a towel over one shoulder.
entries.zh: 格伦费尔听见敲门声，肩上搭着一条毛巾就匆匆下楼了。

entries.en: Jarman waited by the broken gate while I fetched some string.
entries.zh: 贾曼在坏掉的院门旁等着，我去拿一些绳子。

entries.en: The postcard from Jamieson had become stuck between two pages of the atlas.
entries.zh: 从贾米森寄来的明信片卡在了地图册的两页之间。

entries.en: Lawrie moved his bag so the child could sit beside the window.
entries.zh: 劳里挪开自己的包，好让那个孩子坐在窗边。

entries.en: McCann brought the repaired clock back just as we were serving lunch.
entries.zh: 我们正把午饭端上桌时，麦卡恩把修好的钟送回来了。

entries.en: Rodriguez checked every drawer before remembering the spare key was in the shed.
entries.zh: 罗德里格斯找遍每个抽屉后，才想起备用钥匙在棚屋里。

entries.en: Willoughby returned from the market carrying a box of ripe peaches.
entries.zh: 威洛比从市场回来，抱着一箱熟桃子。

entries.en: Gallacher held the torch while we searched for the cat beneath the porch.
entries.zh: 加拉赫举着手电筒，我们则在门廊下寻找那只猫。

entries.en: We put our photographs of Bryce Canyon National Park into a separate album.
entries.zh: 我们把布赖斯峡谷国家公园的照片放进了另一本相册。

entries.en: Leavis caught the falling folder before its contents spilled onto the stairs.
entries.zh: 利维斯接住了掉落的文件夹，没让里面的东西撒到楼梯上。

entries.en: Stormont brought a spare lamp because the room had no overhead light.
entries.zh: 斯托蒙特带来了一盏备用灯，因为那个房间没有顶灯。

entries.en: Aziz offered to look after the bags while we found the ticket office.
entries.zh: 阿齐兹提出帮忙看着行李，让我们去找售票处。

entries.en: Camilla covered the unfinished sculpture before leaving the studio for the night.
entries.zh: 卡蜜拉晚上离开工作室前，把尚未完成的雕塑盖了起来。

entries.en: Fairclough put the freshly washed cups upside down on a clean towel.
entries.zh: 费尔克拉夫把刚洗好的杯子倒扣在一块干净的毛巾上。

entries.en: Downes marked the damaged boxes so nobody would stack them at the bottom.
entries.zh: 唐斯给破损的箱子做了标记，免得有人把它们放在最底下。

entries.en: Meryl moved the vase to make room for the birthday cake.
entries.zh: 梅丽尔挪开花瓶，腾出放生日蛋糕的地方。

entries.en: The newcomer imagined the mining town as an eldorado, then saw the empty shops.
entries.zh: 新来的人把那座矿镇想象成富庶之乡，随后却看到了空荡荡的商店。

entries.en: Ollie searched the garden for the ball until it was too dark to see.
entries.zh: 奥利一直在花园里找球，直到天黑得看不清了。

entries.en: Linford put the wet boots on newspaper rather than directly on the wooden floor.
entries.zh: 林福德把湿靴子放在报纸上，而没有直接放在木地板上。

entries.en: Abdullah waited for the glue to set before lifting the repaired model.
entries.zh: 阿布杜拉等胶水凝固后，才拿起修好的模型。

entries.en: Ewan left the last biscuit for his younger sister and reached for an apple instead.
entries.zh: 尤恩把最后一块饼干留给妹妹，自己则伸手去拿一个苹果。

entries.en: Mitcham pointed out a gap in the fence where the puppy had escaped.
entries.zh: 米查姆指出了篱笆上的一个缺口，小狗就是从那里跑出去的。

entries.en: Diplock put a saucer beneath the dripping tap before phoning the caretaker.
entries.zh: 迪普洛克先在滴水的龙头下面放了一个小碟子，才打电话找管理员。

entries.en: The photograph of Aintree was too large for the frame we had bought.
entries.zh: 那张安特里的照片太大，放不进我们买的相框。

entries.en: Ababa heard the whistle and hurried back to the waiting group.
entries.zh: 阿巴巴听见哨声，就匆匆赶回等着的那群人身边。

entries.en: Morland tested the repaired hinge before putting the cupboard door back on.
entries.zh: 莫兰先试了试修好的铰链，才把柜门装回去。

entries.en: We're spending Chrissie at home this year, with enough chairs for all the neighbours.
entries.zh: 今年我们在家过圣诞节，椅子备得足够让所有邻居都坐下。

entries.en: The photograph mailed from Clacton had a tea stain across one corner.
entries.zh: 那张从克拉克顿寄来的照片有一个角沾上了茶渍。

entries.en: Clarissa opened the parcel slowly, trying not to tear the patterned paper.
entries.zh: 克拉丽莎慢慢地打开包裹，尽量不撕破有花纹的包装纸。

entries.en: Jacqui sorted the buttons by size before putting them into separate tins.
entries.zh: 雅基先按大小把纽扣分好，再放进不同的铁盒。

entries.en: Our photograph of Coniston fell behind the desk when we moved the shelf.
entries.zh: 我们移动架子时，那张科尼斯顿的照片掉到了书桌后面。

entries.en: Minh carried the hot dish with both hands and asked me to open the door.
entries.zh: 明双手端着热菜，请我开门。

entries.en: She kept the old letter from Eurotunnel with the rest of her travel documents.
entries.zh: 她把欧洲隧道公司的旧来信和其他旅行文件放在一起。

entries.en: Kumar placed the toolbox under the bench to keep the doorway clear.
entries.zh: 库马尔把工具箱放到长凳下面，以免挡住门口。

entries.en: Mohammad lent me a clean cloth to wrap around the cracked bowl.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德借给我一块干净的布，让我包住那只裂了的碗。

entries.en: Swinton carefully untangled the necklace before putting it back in its box.
entries.zh: 斯温顿小心地把项链解开，然后放回盒子里。

entries.en: Rourke noticed that the back door was open, went over and closed it.
entries.zh: 鲁尔克发现后门开着，就过去把它关上。

entries.en: Lothar found the missing glove in the pocket of the coat he had worn yesterday.
entries.zh: 洛塔尔在昨天穿的外套口袋里找到了那只丢失的手套。

entries.en: Betsy checked the picnic basket once more before we left the house.
entries.zh: 我们离开家之前，贝琪又检查了一遍野餐篮。

entries.en: Ballesteros held the ladder steady while I took the decorations down.
entries.zh: 我取下装饰品时，巴列斯特罗斯扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: Sharif set the repaired toy beside the child's pillow before leaving.
entries.zh: 沙里夫离开前，把修好的玩具放在了孩子的枕边。

entries.en: Isabelle asked for an empty box to carry the plants home.
entries.zh: 伊莎贝尔要了一个空箱子，好把那些植物带回家。

entries.en: An old photograph of Bicester was tucked into the back of the album.
entries.zh: 相册的最后面夹着一张比斯特的旧照片。

entries.en: Anthea took the wet washing off the line when the first thunderclap sounded.
entries.zh: 第一声雷响时，安西娅把湿衣物从晾衣绳上收了下来。

entries.en: Billingham took a spare umbrella from the cupboard and handed it to our visitor.
entries.zh: 比林汉姆从柜子里拿出一把备用伞，递给了我们的客人。

entries.en: The spilled cocktail left a faintly ginny aroma on the tablecloth.
entries.zh: 洒出来的鸡尾酒在桌布上留下了一丝杜松子酒的香气。

entries.en: Lucinda slid a piece of cardboard beneath the cake before lifting it.
entries.zh: 露辛达把一块硬纸板滑到蛋糕底下，然后才把蛋糕托起来。

entries.en: Fenn found a sheltered spot where we could fold the map without fighting the wind.
entries.zh: 芬恩找到了一个避风处，让我们能不受风的干扰把地图折好。

entries.en: The little parcel from Stornoway contained the scarf I had forgotten there.
entries.zh: 从斯托诺韦寄来的小包裹里，装着我遗忘在那里的围巾。

entries.en: Mr Rabin left a clean towel beside the basin for our guest.
entries.zh: 拉宾先生在洗脸盆旁为我们的客人放了一条干净毛巾。

entries.en: Knighton caught the windblown papers before they reached the puddle by the gate.
entries.zh: 奈顿赶在风吹走的纸张落进门边的水坑之前接住了它们。

entries.en: Hasan offered to carry the smaller suitcase while I pushed the pram.
entries.zh: 哈桑提出帮忙提较小的手提箱，我则推着婴儿车。

entries.en: Mahoney packed the spare batteries in a separate pocket of the camera bag.
entries.zh: 马奥尼把备用电池装进了相机包的一个独立口袋。

entries.en: Matthey waited until the hallway was clear before bringing the long mirror inside.
entries.zh: 马泰等走廊腾空后，才把那面长镜子搬进去。

entries.en: Perot remembered the spare chairs just as our last guests arrived.
entries.zh: 最后几位客人到来时，佩罗才想起那些备用椅子。

entries.en: Penh carried the empty crates back to the shed after the party.
entries.zh: 聚会结束后，边把空板条箱搬回了棚屋。

entries.meaningZh: 电视信息咨询服务〔英国历史服务名〕
entries.en: The collector showed us an old booklet about Prestel with a torn blue cover.
entries.zh: 收藏者给我们看了一本介绍 Prestel 电视信息服务的旧小册子，蓝色封面已经破了。

entries.en: Botha handed me the umbrella while searching for the key in a coat pocket.
entries.zh: 博塔一边在外套口袋里找钥匙，一边把伞递给了我。

entries.en: Milosevic set a bowl beneath the dripping roof and moved the books away.
entries.zh: 米洛舍维奇在滴水的屋顶下面放了一个碗，并把书移开。

entries.en: Honecker returned to the shop because the parcel was missing its ribbon.
entries.zh: 昂纳克回到了商店，因为包裹上少了丝带。

entries.en: Eubank carried the heavy frame upstairs while I held the doors open.
entries.zh: 尤班克把沉重的框架搬上楼，我则帮忙撑着门。

entries.en: Shevardnadze noticed a loose button and borrowed a needle before leaving the house.
entries.zh: 谢瓦尔德纳泽发现一颗纽扣松了，出门前借了一根针。

entries.en: Birt put the wrapped sandwiches on top so they would not be crushed.
entries.zh: 伯特把包好的三明治放在最上面，免得它们被压扁。

entries.meaningZh: 巴利米纳〔北爱尔兰地名〕
entries.en: The photograph of Ballymena reminded us of the camera we had lost on that trip.
entries.zh: 那张巴利米纳的照片，让我们想起了那次旅行中丢失的相机。

entries.en: She borrowed a book about the Mariana Islands for her photography project.
entries.zh: 她为自己的摄影项目借了一本介绍马里亚纳群岛的书。

entries.en: Clowes fetched a second tray when we ran out of space for the cups.
entries.zh: 我们没有地方放杯子时，克洛斯又拿来一个托盘。

entries.en: Gilbey made room on the bench for a visitor with a large bag.
entries.zh: 吉尔比在长凳上腾出地方，让一位带着大包的来访者坐下。

entries.en: The letter from Braintree arrived inside a larger envelope with several old photographs.
entries.zh: 那封从布伦特里寄来的信，和几张旧照片一起装在一个更大的信封里送到了。

entries.en: Lucie put a dry cloth on the shelf before setting down the wet flowerpot.
entries.zh: 露西先在架子上铺了一块干布，才把湿花盆放下。

entries.en: I put my old Timex watch in a small box before packing the rest.
entries.zh: 收拾其余东西之前，我把那块旧天美时手表放进了一个小盒子。

entries.en: Offa found a clean corner of the table for the unfinished jigsaw puzzle.
entries.zh: 奥法在桌上找到一个干净的角落，放那幅还没拼好的拼图。

entries.meaningZh: 利库德集团〔政治组织名〕
entries.en: The researcher placed an old Likud leaflet beside the other campaign material.
entries.zh: 研究者把一张利库德集团的旧传单放在了其他竞选材料旁。

entries.en: Galerie checked the weather before deciding where to hang the washing.
entries.zh: 加莱里先查看了天气，才决定把洗好的衣物晾在哪里。

entries.en: Adorno kept the receipt in case the new lamp had to be returned.
entries.zh: 阿多诺留着收据，以备那盏新灯需要退货。

entries.en: Rohan moved the basket out of the doorway without waking the sleeping kitten.
entries.zh: 罗翰把篮子从门口挪开，没有吵醒睡着的小猫。

entries.en: Hinkley found the missing cup beneath a folded blanket on the chair.
entries.zh: 欣克利在椅子上一条折好的毯子下面找到了丢失的杯子。

entries.en: Assad offered to carry the fragile model while we took the larger boxes.
entries.zh: 阿萨德提出拿那个易损的模型，我们则搬那些更大的箱子。

entries.en: Bhutto placed the freshly cut flowers in water before answering the telephone.
entries.zh: 布托先把刚剪下的花插进水里，才去接电话。

entries.en: Aung counted the empty chairs and brought two more from the kitchen.
entries.zh: 昂数了数空椅子，又从厨房搬来两把。

entries.en: Wolverton moved the lampshade aside to see where the screw had fallen.
entries.zh: 沃尔弗顿挪开灯罩，想看看螺丝掉在了哪里。

entries.en: We looked through photographs of Florian while deciding which café to include in the album.
entries.zh: 我们翻看了佛罗莱恩咖啡馆的照片，决定把哪家咖啡馆收入相册。

entries.en: Collor found enough hooks for all the coats except the one I was wearing.
entries.zh: 科洛尔找到了足够的挂钩，能挂下除我身上那件以外的所有外套。
